title: astragalus angustifolius subsp. echinoides
intro: Astragalus angustifolius subsp. echinoides, commonly known as a type of milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus angustifolius subsp. echinoides include reducing fatigue, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
